_comment: Default bindings for the DualShock 2 this package declares. The frontend ships no
bindings of its own - a package that declares a controller says how it is played by
default, and the user's own bindings always win.
The face buttons follow the pad's own geometry rather than a keyboard's alphabet:
Cross is the bottom one and takes the key under the hand, Circle the right, Square
the left, Triangle the top. The shoulders sit above and below each other the way they
do on the controller. Analog is a real button on a DualShock 2 - it switches the pad
between digital and analog mode, which a game can see - so it is bound rather than
